title: Moodboard to Room
description: Interview eight opinionated guests, pack a limited furniture kit, arrange a 3D room, discover hidden quirks through live messages, and earn a judged guestbook result.

prompt.objective: Build a cozy room-design game where learning each guest guides every choice.

mintAssets.brief: Thirteen minimalist, cottagecore, and Y2K furnishings.

experience: Ask one question, pack a kit, furnish the room, paint walls, and tune light.
Read guest clues, invite them in, earn stars, and learn through retries.
prompt.visualDirection: Warm interiors, soft serif type, tactile cards, rainy-day coziness, and polaroid results.

thumbnail.alt: A furnished sage-green bedroom with a platform bed, chair, plants, and woven rugs inside the room-design game.

social.title: Moodboard to Room
social.description: Interview a guest, pack a limited kit, build their 3D room, and discover what they really wanted through play.
